title: Door-to-Door Sales Workers, News and Street Vendors, and Related Workers
description: Sell goods or services door-to-door or on the street.

projection.title: Door-to-door sales workers, news and street vendors, and related workers

tasks.text: Explain products or services and prices and demonstrate use of products.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical explanation to customers needs live interaction

dwas.name: Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI analyzes market data to identify prospects
decision support — AI can arrange deliveries; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Arrange delivery of goods or services.

tasks.text: Write and record orders for merchandise or enter orders into computers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Order capture automatable; customer interaction partly human

tasks.text: Arrange buying parties and solicit sponsorship of such parties to sell merchandise.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Campaign coordination needs human judgment and relationships

dwas.name: Contact current or potential customers to promote products or services.

tasks.text: Answer questions about product features and benefits.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product questions answered from knowledge base

dwas.name: Answer customer questions about goods or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Distribute product samples or literature that details products or services.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically distributing samples and literature

dwas.name: Distribute promotional literature or samples to customers.

tasks.text: Circulate among potential customers or travel by foot, truck, automobile, or bicycle to deliver or sell merchandise or services.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can arrange deliveries; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Arrange delivery of goods or services.

tasks.text: Persuade customers to purchase merchandise or services.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Closing sales requires persuasion and accountability

tasks.text: Set up and display sample merchandise at parties or stands.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Setting up displays requires hands-on placement
decision support — Merchandise purchasing aided; human owns buying decisions

dwas.name: Purchase stocks of merchandise or supplies.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically moving and shelving stock items

emerging_tasks.task: Contact customers to ensure their satisfaction with products or services.
Train new recruits or other employees.
